SPEC_TEXT: DOC-C fixes auth.otac_resend_cooldown_ms at 60000 ms, states resend cooldown = 60s, permits request-otac retry only after cooldown, returns cooldown_seconds, and defines 429 RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED for the rate-limit rejection path.
EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: POST /api/auth/request-otac enforces a 60-second resend cooldown and does not admit a retry before the cooldown expires; the canonical rate-limit rejection is HTTP 429 RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.
FORBIDDEN_BEHAVIOR: Accepting a resend before the 60-second cooldown expires.
NOTE: DOC-C establishes the cooldown semantics but does not prescribe a particular email canonicalization algorithm. Task T-C84E61B2 independently requires that email case variants cannot bypass the cooldown bucket.
